formal: if len(active) > limit then return False, 0
if not (len(active) > limit) then return True, limit - len(active)
limit_sensor(timestamps, now, window, limit) returns (bool, int) where bool indicates if sensor action is allowed
limit_sensor(timestamps, now, window, limit) returns (status, remaining) where remaining >= 0
active = [t for t in timestamps if t >= (now - window)]
if len(active) == 0 then remaining == limit, if len(active) >= limit then status == False
if len(active) increases then remaining decreases or stays same
limit_sensor(timestamps, now, window, limit) == limit_sensor(timestamps, now, window, limit) for same inputs
same inputs always produce same outputs
only timestamps >= (now - window) are considered in active count
BUG: when len(active) == limit, returns True, 0 (permits one extra action)
